persons.name: Jayākara
persons.evidence: ācāryamūrttiguṇa alaṅkṛtaṃ śrījayākaranāmalabdam | sarve svagotrasakalasatva uttāraṇā〈〈rtha〉〉rthakaaraṇam

relations.evidence: śrīnepālasya vijayarājye mahācchrīharṣadevarājaṣu | lekhakaḥ śrīpaśupatisthānā saṃjñā govarddhanāṅkitaḥ
lekhakaḥ śrīpaśupatisthānā saṃjñā govarddhanāṅkitaḥ ... ācāryamūrttiguṇa alaṅkṛtaṃ śrījayākaranāmalabdam

date.as_written: dviśate samvacchare tīte saptadaśasapūritaḥ | phālguṇasya tu "sukla sya uttameṣu trayodaśī | tārakā pūrvaphalgunyā śukragrahasuśobhane

notes: The scribe Govarddhana is from Paśupatisthāna. Jayākara is associated with Phaṇāṅka in Cūḍāmaṇiviṣaya.
